EN: The goal of career mode is to build your space program from its fledgling roots to an epic undertaking \nthat reaches the limits of the solar system. Seeing a fully advanced KSC with kerbals orbiting or walking \non planets throughout the system is an amazing reward.

It adds making decisions about 
contracts, crew assignments, 
strategies and a number of other 
activities, to your already busy job 
of building and flying missions.


So let's look at some of the details.
The career mode of Kerbal Space Program adds some directed play to the game. It's mostly procedurally \ngenerated, so it will not be the same on each playthrough.
Your KSP Career

To advance your career you will need to take on contracts from the various companies based on Kerbin. 
The rewards, goals and timelines for these will vary depending on your reach into the system and your 
reputation.


You will sometimes be offered contracts 
related to vessels or kerbals you have 
out there too, so keep an eye out for 
opportunities. 


Be aware that turning down (or failing) 
contracts will cost you in Reputation and 
sometimes even Funds and Science.

This society of kerbal philanthropists is interested in the advancement of space exploration. They reward \nspace programs for doing things that have never been done before.<color=#ef2929>*</color> Through this group you may find \nyourself getting unexpected rewards.

Working for The Man

The brainiacs of kerbal society. These guys and girls spend their time 
unravelling the universe (we just hope they get it put back together 
by dinner-time). When situated in a mobile processing lab they can 
increase the science earned significantly.

The whole of kerbal society is knocking at the door to be involved in your Space Program. With the \nseemingly endless list of applicants you will find that there are three areas (or roles) that kerbals \nspecialize in.

These kerbals are mechanical wunderkind. They can repair a number \nof broken parts, as well as increase the efficiency of drilling operations. \nThey all strive to attain status like their hero MacGyver Kerman.
Sometimes thought of as the rockstars of space exploration, pilots \nare focused on ship control and get better as they experience more \nsituations.

Reputation is earned through the successful completion of contracts. 
The better your reputation the better (and more rewarding) the 
contracts you will be offered. 

Reputation can be traded for other currencies via strategies, as well 
as being lost if kerbals go missing, so don't ignore it.

Your Funds pay for vessel builds, hire astronauts, upgrade/repair \nfacilities and on harder difficulties even buy parts as you research. \nHaving enough to keep up with your planned missions is critical.
Some would say Science is the whole reason for any space program. \nCompleting experiments and extending your kerbals' reach into \nspace are the primary ways to generate Science.
Recovering vessels on Kerbin will net you some handy salvage funds \n(the closer to the KSC you land the more return you get), but your \nmain source of Funds are contracts.
This is used to unlock new technology and parts, to build on \nsuccesses and get further afield.
Throughout your career there are three currencies to keep an eye on.
